run.notes: Sample of what steps 7 and 8 hand to Phase 4, built from the Veloran reference report v1.0 (a synthetic case). Base hours and costs are the report's; the low and high hour ranges are illustrative until step 8 supplies real ones.

sources.loaded_hourly_rate: Average salary $118,000 x 1.30 for benefits and payroll taxes, plus $19,400 overhead per person, divided by 1,920 working hours (Veloran finance, FY2025)
sources.working_weeks_per_year: 52 weeks minus PTO and holidays (Veloran handbook)
sources.adoption_rate: Conservative planning assumption (70%), applied to every saving; 50% and 85% for the low and high cases

bottlenecks.name: Staffing blind spots: unplanned bench time and last-minute assignments
root_causes: No forward view of capacity: the staffing sheet tracks current bookings only
Sales and delivery plan separately: start dates live in CRM opportunities the staffing sheet never reads
Bench time has no default use

evidence.signal: Billable time on bench or internal codes with no booking
Date a booking appears against the project start
Contract signature against first billable hour

upside_not_counted.label: Half of unplanned bench becomes billable
upside_not_counted.basis: 28.5 hours a week x 48 weeks x $158 realized rate

bottlenecks.name: Status reporting repeated across four places and recurring meetings
root_causes: No single system of record: three tools grew up in different teams
Meetings collect status instead of making decisions
Client reporting is hand-built in a bespoke format per client

evidence.signal: Same project updated in several tools in one week
evidence.source: Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, Google Drive decks

evidence.signal: Recurring internal events named stand-up, review or health
evidence.value: 3 recurring meetings; 70% of agenda time on read-outs

bottlenecks.name: Timesheets rebuilt from memory at the end of the week
root_causes: Weekly deadline, daily work: nothing prompts entry while memory is fresh
Entry is fully manual: the time tool does not read calendars or the tracker
No visible link between timesheets and money

evidence.signal: Calendar and tracker activity with no matching time entry

upside_not_counted.label: Unlogged billable hours captured
upside_not_counted.basis: 70% of 1,669 unlogged hours x $158 realized rate
